title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-lina-2026-03-18
content:
Daily triage scratchpad - Lina

Context:
- Quick notes for console/observability triage. Mixing action items, short investigations, and follow-ups.
- Primary focus: dashboard rendering bugs reported by customers + alert noise spike from prod region us-west-2.

---
03/18 09:10 - Morning check
- Pager: alert storm (error-rate spike) on /generate endpoint in us-west-2. Linked alert: JIRA-4592.
- Dashboard load times also slow for some customers (reported by Acme Corp via support ticket).
- Slack: #obs-triage thread started by @samir ~08:55 with heap of logs.

Immediate actions (done):
- Re-routed 10% traffic to fallback model variant. (temp mitigation)
- Notified SRE oncall (Jordan). Jordan confirmed autoscaler flapping around 08:45-09:00.
- Created JIRA-4592 to track root cause + postmortem.

Things to investigate (next):
- [ ] Investigate autoscaler behavior in us-west-2: look at recent deploys, scale policy changes, and CPU/GPU utilization around 08:30-09:10. (ask infra: did we bump target utilization?)
- [ ] Check serving-runtime logs for KV cache thrashing - could explain latency + error increase. grep for OOM/failed-alloc.
- [ ] Dashboard rendering bug: customer says graphs show "No data" for token-quantiles even though logs show traffic. Reproduce with Acme's org id on staging? Might be query time range mismatch.
- [ ] Check metric ingestion pipeline (observability-ingest): Was there lag? Last known spike in ingestion lag at 08:40 per metrics-collector.

Notes from quick log skim (09:25):
- Multiple 5xx spikes with message: "KVCache: failed to fetch shard 12 - txn timeout". Timing aligns with autoscaler events.
- Metrics ingestion: rdb-write latency jumped to 1.2s for a 3m window at 08:42.
- Dashboard backend returned HTTP 200 with empty series for token-quantiles queries (query window defaults changed?). Suspect frontend query param change in last console deploy (review deploy diff).

Customer follow-up drafted (support):
- "Thanks for flagging — we're investigating a transient backend issue that affected metric rendering and inference latency in us-west-2 this morning. We've routed traffic to a fallback and are actively tracking a fix; I'll follow up with a status update in 2 hours or earlier if we have new details. Apologies for the disruption."

Actions assigned:
- Lina: reproduce dashboard rendering issue on staging with Acme org id + check console frontend commit history (PRs in past 24h).
- Jordan: deep-dive autoscaler logs + check for recent policy changes; correlate with k8s evictions.
- Samir: trace serving-runtime KV cache errors; collect full stack traces and pod ids.

Follow-ups / open items:
- [ ] Postmortem template pre-fill for JIRA-4592 (owner: Jordan).
- [ ] Confirm whether fallback routing caused any degradation for other regions. (Lina to check routing logs)
- [ ] Evaluate adding alert to detect rapid autoscaler oscillation (pager fatigue protection).
- [ ] If metric ingestion lag recurs, open a separate ticket against observability-ingest team.

Quick reproductions / commands I ran:
- kubectl -n runtime logs --since=30m pod/serving-runtime-abc123 | grep "KVCache"
- curl "https://console-staging.internal/api/metrics?org=acme&metric=token-quantiles&start=..." (got empty series)
- git log --since=2.days --pretty=oneline console-frontend | head -n 10 -> saw PR #7864 merged yesterday.

Ideas / hypotheses:
- hypothesis A: recent frontend change altered default time window -> frontend sending narrower range -> backend returns empty series while metrics are delayed due to ingestion lag. Explains "No data" but logs show traffic.
- hypothesis B: KV cache shard timeouts caused by sudden eviction/GC -> increases backend errors and leads to 5xx on generate endpoint. Autoscaler triggers due to perceived high load, causing more evictions -> feedback loop.

Notes-to-self:
- When writing postmortem, include timeline: alert start -> autoscaler events -> KV errors -> metric ingestion lag -> frontend deploy merge.
- Record customer impact: Acme dashboards blank (UX), some requests 5xx.

Misc smaller items / TODOs:
- [ ] Add short how-to in runbook for "re-route to fallback model" (I keep forgetting exact traffic percents).
- [ ] Update dashboard that shows autoscaler oscillation metric (add 1m rate).
- [ ] Ping product about customers that rely on token-quantile graphs (priority list).

Scratch log (timestamps):
- 08:43 - Alert fired: /generate error-rate spike us-west-2.
- 08:47 - Autoscaler scaled down 2 pods, then back up (flapping).
- 08:55 - Samir posts initial KVCache stack snippets in Slack.
- 09:05 - Fallback routing applied (10%).
- 09:22 - Confirmed ingestion lag spike at 08:42.

Reference links:
- JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-4592
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OBS/pages/obs-dashboards
- Slack thread: slack://channel/obs-triage/thread/ghi123

Final quick plan (next 2 hours):
- 09:30-10:00: Lina attempts repro + frontend PR diff check.
- 10:00-11:00: Jordan + Samir correlation and root cause narrowing.
- 11:00: Update support + affected customers with preliminary findings.

--
Notes intentionally terse. Will expand once we have logs + root cause.
summary: Morning triage notes for us-west-2 incident: autoscaler flapping + KV cache timeouts causing dashboard no-data and 5xxs; mitigation applied (fallback routing); actions assigned to Lina/Jordan/Samir.
